proposals.name: Detached shell CSM rebrightening
proposals.idea: The roughly constant early flux is the slowly fading tail of the original supernova, not its peak. At about t_hit the ejecta reached a detached circumstellar shell, adding a second shock-powered component that is now rising toward its own maximum.

old_b.meaning: fading pre-interaction supernova flux per band at day -30 in microjansky

new_b.meaning: peak flux of the new CSM shock component per band in microjansky

tau_old.meaning: exponential fading timescale of the original supernova tail in days

t_hit.meaning: day the ejecta struck the detached shell

dur_peak.meaning: days from shell impact to maximum of the interaction component

alpha.meaning: power-law rise index of the interaction component

proposals.predicts: A second, nearly achromatic maximum near t_hit+dur_peak, about +7 days at roughly 70 microjansky, followed by a decline, instead of the monotonic fading predicted by the single-peak hypotheses.

proposals.name: Dark-lens microlensing event
proposals.idea: An unseen compact dark lens is transiting in front of a background star in or behind the host, gravitationally magnifying it. The long near-constant baseline followed by a slow, nearly achromatic accelerating rise is the approach to closest alignment, not an explosion.

t_peak.meaning: day of closest lens-source alignment relative to now

u0.meaning: minimum impact parameter in Einstein-radius units

src_b.meaning: unmagnified flux of the lensed source in this band

base_b.meaning: unlensed blend and host flux in this band

proposals.predicts: It predicts an achromatic, time-symmetric decline after t_peak mirroring the rise toward the constant source colour, with no supernova-like cooling, reddening, or spectral evolution.

proposals.name: Precursor plateau plus late ignition
proposals.idea: A near-constant ~30 microJy plateau for over 20 days is a separate progenitor outburst or circumstellar interaction, not a supernova peak. A second expanding-ejecta component ignited about 11 days ago and is now rising on top of that plateau, so the single-component Ia, Ibc and TDE fits mistook the plateau for a fading peak.

base_b.meaning: constant precursor and host flux per band in microJy

amp_b.meaning: peak scale of the newly ignited component per band in microJy

t0.meaning: ignition day of the second component relative to now

tau_rise.meaning: rise timescale of the new component in days

n_rise.meaning: power-law index of the early fireball rise

tau_decay.meaning: eventual decay timescale of the new component in days

proposals.predicts: It predicts the flux will keep rising for the next 1-3 weeks, reaching well above 150 microJy before turning over, instead of fading to about 20 microJy as the failed hypotheses forecast.
